sourceText:
Stracciatella
By: Cardassiana
Published: Sunday, January 2, 2011 - 2:21am

Ingredients




Chicken soup
little egg pasta
an egg
salt
pepper
Parmesan cheese

Preparation

1 Here is a soup ready in 5 minutes. 2 Break your egg into the plate, add a dash of pepper, salt and lots of cheese. 3 Scramble the egg. 4 Meanwhile  thrown in the broth  a handful of egg pasta. 5 When it's almost cooked slide the egg into the pan and stir well. 6 Yum !!!!!!
